module TopModule(input  clk, input  areset, input  bump_left, input  bump_right, input  ground, output reg walk_left, output reg walk_right, output reg aaah);
    reg [1:0] state, nextstate;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'd0;
        else state <= nextstate;
    end
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'd0: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 0; if (bump_left) nextstate = 2'd1; else if (bump_right) nextstate = 2'd2; else if (!ground) nextstate = 2'd3; else nextstate = 2'd0; end
            2'd1: begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 1; aaah = 0; if (bump_left) nextstate = 2'd1; else if (bump_right) nextstate = 2'd2; else if (!ground) nextstate = 2'd3; else nextstate = 2'd0; end
            2'd2: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 0; if (bump_left) nextstate = 2'd1; else if (bump_right) nextstate = 2'd2; else if (!ground) nextstate = 2'd3; else nextstate = 2'd0; end
            2'd3: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 1; if (bump_left) nextstate = 2'd1; else if (bump_right) nextstate = 2'd2; else if (ground) nextstate = 2'd0; else nextstate = 2'd3; end
        endcase
    end
endmodule

// Moore Finite State Machine
module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  bump_left,
    input  bump_right,
    input  ground,
    output reg walk_left,
    output reg walk_right,
    output reg aaah
);
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; next_state = (bump_left) ? 2'b01 : (bump_right) ? 2'b10 : 2'b00; aaah = 0; end
            2'b01: begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 1; next_state = (bump_left) ? 2'b01 : (bump_right) ? 2'b10 : (ground) ? 2'b00 : 2'b01; aaah = 0; end
            2'b10: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; next_state = (bump_left) ? 2'b01 : (bump_right) ? 2'b10 : (ground) ? 2'b00 : 2'b10; aaah = 0; end
            default: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; next_state = 2'b00; aaah = 0; end
        endcase
        if (!ground && (bump_left || bump_right)) aaah <= 1;
        else aaah <= 0;
    end
endmodule

module TopModule(input clk, input areset, input bump_left, input bump_right, input ground, output reg walk_left, output reg walk_right, output reg aaah);
    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 0; if (bump_right) next_state = 2'b10; else if (bump_left) next_state = 2'b01; else next_state = 2'b00; end
            2'b01: begin walk_left = 1; walk_right = 0; aaah = 0; if (bump_right) next_state = 2'b10; else if (bump_left) next_state = 2'b01; else next_state = 2'b01; end
            2'b10: begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 1; aaah = 0; if (bump_right) next_state = 2'b10; else if (bump_left) next_state = 2'b01; else next_state = 2'b10; end
            2'b11: begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 1; aaah = 0; if (bump_right) next_state = 2'b10; else if (bump_left) next_state = 2'b01; else next_state = 2'b11; end
        endcase
        if (!ground) begin walk_left = 0; walk_right = 0; aaah = 1; next_state = 2'b11; end
    end
endmodule
